foyer.name: Foyer
foyer.description: A dusty foyer. Marble floors are cracked under your feet, and a cold draft curls down from somewhere above.

library.name: Library
library.description: Tall shelves loom in the gloom, packed with books whose spines have long since faded to grey. A narrow iron grate is set into the floor at the far end.

down.locked_message: The iron grate covering the stairs down is padlocked shut.

garden.name: Overgrown Garden
garden.description: Ivy has swallowed what must once have been carefully tended beds. A single rose still blooms, improbably red.

cellar.name: Cellar
cellar.description: Damp stone walls crowd close. Rusted hooks hang from the ceiling, and a long shape rests on a stone bench against the far wall.
cellar.dark_description: You are in pitch darkness. The air is cold and smells of old iron. You can hear the faint drip of water somewhere nearby.

brass_lantern.name: brass lantern
brass_lantern.description: A tarnished brass lantern, cold to the touch but heavier than it looks.

toggle.on_message: You light the lantern, and its flame throws long shadows against the walls.
toggle.off_message: You snuff the lantern's flame. The shadows fold back in.

rusted_key.name: rusted key
rusted_key.description: An iron key, rust-pitted but still solid. It bears the faint shape of a library seal.

stone_plaque.name: stone plaque
stone_plaque.description: A weathered stone plaque set into the wall. The original inscription has eroded beyond reading.

old_book.name: old book
old_book.description: A leather-bound book, its pages brittle and its title long since flaked away.

use_effect.message: You thumb through the pages. A loose sheet mentions a lost king named Arell and a stair that descends from the library.

health_potion.name: health potion
health_potion.description: A small glass vial of dark red liquid. It is faintly warm.

use_effect.message: You drink the potion. Warmth spreads through your limbs and the ache in your shoulder fades.

garden_key.name: garden key
garden_key.description: A delicate brass key with a leaf-shaped bow. It looks far too slender for any of the iron locks in this house.

use_effect.message: You try the garden key, but it fits no lock here.

tarnished_sword.name: tarnished sword
tarnished_sword.description: A longsword with a tarnished grip. The edge is still surprisingly keen.

ghost.name: pale ghost
ghost.description: A translucent figure that drifts without sound. Its eyes are fixed on something you cannot see.

script.text: The foyer is colder than I remember.

adventurer.name: confused adventurer
adventurer.description: A young man in muddy travelling clothes, holding an unrolled map upside down. He keeps glancing at the floor.

script.text: I'm sure the stairs were around here somewhere...
shuffles in a slow circle, peering at the floor
